_doc: Step 06 Fun Lab variants: overrides on top of balance.json (the base, kept unchanged as the reference). Same action, same currency, same atelier; each variant makes a different reward the main one. design/VARIANTS.md has the hypotheses.

a._why: A - the feel of winding: holding coils a visible mainspring (no energy yet); letting go releases it all at once. A tap still winds and releases in one.

b._why: B - the awakening itself: every sleeping doll is hidden under a dust sheet, and each wakes in a longer reveal with its own look and gesture.

c._why: C - dolls wake dolls: an awakening is short and, when it ends, the new doll at once turns the next sleeper's key (an instant kick of its rate x kick_seconds), so awakenings run into each other like dominoes.
c._step12: Owner-approved candidate (2026-11-03). Tuned by the pacing lab against criteria written before measuring (design/EXPANSION_PROPOSAL.md): first doll 55 -> 40 so a casual player meets it in ~19 s; the x1.25 rate bonus removed so an engaged player does not wake all twelve before 10 minutes and clicking still matters there (x1.4). The kick stays. The tournament's C (x1.25, 55) is frozen in docs/windup/ref/step11/.
